text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

SOYBEAN SALES - USDA said Friday China bought 249,800 tonnes soybeans in the week ended Nov 7 and 54,200 tonnes soybean meal. In its weekly export sales report, USDA also said China bought 10,000 tonnes soybean oil. It said China's soybean purchases included new sales of 99,500 tonnes and changes in destination of 150,300 tonnes.
WHEAT SALES - A Philippine firm bought 12,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for November 24 shipment, traders said on Friday.

WHEAT SALE - The CCC of USDA said on Thursday it had purchased 80,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat for export to Bangladesh, December 1-25 shipment. Continental Grain sold 17,250 tonnes at $154.49 per tonne, FOB Kalama, WA, 17,250 tonnes at $155.19, FOB Vancover, WA and 13,000 tonnes at $158.34, FOB Tacoma, WA. Cargill sold 23,000 tonnes at $154.46 and 9,500 tonnes at $155.93, FOB Portland, OR.

WHEAT SOY BLEND SALE - The CCC of USDA said on Thursday it had purchased 380 tonnes of U.S. wheat-soy blend for export to Iraq, November 25-December 10 shipment. ADM Milling Co sold the blend for $442.35 per tonne, FOB, Jacintoport, Texas.

CORN SALE - Taiwan's Members Feed Industry Group bought on Friday a 54,000-tonne shipment of U.S. no.2 corn from Garnac, traders said. Shipment was due Feb 21-March 7 U.S. Gulf and/or March 7-22, PNW, for 88.88 US cents/CBOT March.
WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC was tendering on November 20 for up to 16,910 tonnes of U.S. number two hard red winter wheat for export to Mozambique. Shipment was slated for Dec 5-31.

- The CCC said it was tendering on November 21 for up to 16,100 tonnes of U.S. wheat for export to Iraq. Shipment was slated for December 5-30. It sought number two or better wheat, excluding unclassed, mixed and durum wheat.

WHEAT TENDERS - The Egyptian state's General Authority for Supply Commodities said on Friday it was inviting bids for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat, any type, for loading between Dec 17 and 31. The deadline for bids is 7.45 a.m. Cairo time (0545 GMT) on Nov 16 and bids should be valid until Monday morning. The tender runs in parallel with three others -- for 100,000 tonnes of Argentine wheat, 50,000 tonnes of soft white Australian wheat and 50,000 tonnes of French soft red wheat.
- Pakistan is likely to tender for at least 200,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat in a about a week's time, a Ministry of Food and Agriculture official said.

CORN TENDER - South Africa Maize Board was offering 30,000 tonnes yellow maize for export or domestic use. The offer closes November 21. If for export use, the maize would be shipped ding December as a single 30,000 tonne unit.

RICE TENDER - Jamaica is tendering on November 18 for 2,500 tonnes of U.S. bulk brown rice under the GSM-102 program, agents for the buyer said. The rice can be offered FOB U.S. Gulf for December 1-20 delivery or cost and freight Montego Bay, December 21-27 delivery, the agent said.

MARKET TALK - U.S. Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman said following talks with the European Union's farm commissioner Franz Fischler that the EU was honouring a commitment not to undercut U.S. wheat prices and was not using wheat export subsidies aggressively. But he reiterated after talks with Fischler in Rome on Thursday night that while the U.S. had no present plans to re-introduce its own subsidies, such a decision had not been ruled out...Philippine flour mills are expected to stay away from the grains market next week due to ample stocks, traders said.
